dbOutcome.summary: Keep Bottle 45174 and add exact edition Cask No. 71 plus vintageYear 2019. Preserve age 4, 55.8% ABV, singleCask true, caskStrength true, and releaseYear null. Do not merge or create a Bottle.

catalogFieldObservations.notes: The production image literally prints CASK NO 71. Independent importer and retailer pages market the release as Single Cask #71; the observed failed audit misread the handwritten 7 as 1 and proposed bare edition 11.
The production label explicitly prints distilled 18.06.19, which is a distillation vintage and not a release year.

provenance.notes: Observed August 1, 2026 from Bottle Check #2 for production Bottle 45174. The check proposed edition 11 because normalized image extraction lost the literal CASK NO marker and misread 71. Re-verification used the exact public Peated image: CASK NO 71, BOTTLE NO 009/340, distilled 18.06.19, aged 4 YEARS, and 55.8% ABV. JVS Imports, DRINQY, and K&L independently market Pōkeno Single Cask #71; DRINQY also states 4 years and 55.8% ABV. Importer and retailer ABV/outturn text is not perfectly consistent, so the fixture takes the exact ABV and bottle count from the observed label while using those sources to corroborate the marketed Cask 71 identity.

expected.summary: Bottle 45174 is the Pōkeno four-year-old single-cask release marketed as Cask No. 71; its stored exact identity is missing the cask marker and 2019 distillation vintage.

proposedOperations.rationale: The public label and independent product evidence identify this exact marketed Bottle as Cask No. 71, and the label explicitly states a 2019 distillation date.
